about_the_game:
• The Demo includes the first two chapters!

  • Some content may not be available in this verrsion of the game.

A terrible enemy emerged from the darkness with a powerful spell that changed everything forever.

When chaos arose, the sky began to be covered with ash and your destiny had already marked your path.

Collect, craft, explore, defeat powerful enemies, forge your own weapons, customize your equipment, complete dungeons, solve puzzles and dominate the terrain in this grand open world RPG focused on a retro yet innovative experience.

Will you be able to overthrow Team Prism and their leader?

What ending will you meet? Your decisions are important!

Despite everything, a mysterious force hides between this game and reality...

If it comes to contacting you, god have mercy.

content_descriptors.notes: Chaos of Destiny features intense narrative elements, emotionally complex themes, and moments that may be disturbing or sensitive for some players. While it does not include extreme graphic violence or sexual content, the moral weight of decisions, dark atmosphere, and impactful events make it more suitable for adult or young adult audiences who appreciate deep storytelling.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Microsoft Windows 7/8/8.1/10 (32bit/64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Microsoft Windows 7/8/8.1/10 (32bit/64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo
  • Graphics: OpenGL ES 2.0 hardware driver support required for WebGL acceleration. (AMD Catalyst 10.9, nVidia 358.50), iOS 8.0, Android 4.4.4*
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
